name: open-scientist
description: General-purpose research plugin for any field. ResearchStudio idea_spark (synced to upstream #63) as the generator, with layers of three declared kinds inserted at phase boundaries: rank (mainline-first problem formulation; problem-selection over a cross-run card registry), verify (an independent soundness verifier on code + literature only — never the project's own scores — at gap, mechanism and card level, plus phenomenon admission and a protocol audit), and the solution-side core: classical-theory recall and modeling (original problem → construction → preserved property → mapping) whose construction RS Phase 2 transports. Domain switch OPEN_SCIENTIST_DOMAIN=ml|general (general = arXiv + OpenReview).
